notes: Implements the debug variant of GPUv1-A07 exactly: a real CUDA DLRM with a 13->8 numeric bottom MLP, 26 independent 8-dim embedding tables built from train rows only (unknown -> index 0), all pairwise dot interactions (351), top MLP to a logit, BCEWithLogitsLoss and real Adam gradient updates. Every training row is updated 30 times and coverage is verified in run.json. Numeric normalisation (mean/std) and category maps are persisted in checkpoint.pt so `predict` reproduces identical feature semantics in a separate process. `doctor --input input` inspects only the three required input files, their manifest sha256 digests, torch/CUDA availability and schema shape, returns 78 when anything is missing and 0 otherwise, without executing training. `--help` works without loading any model. Checks for interaction structure, 26 embedding tables, real parameter change, full input coverage, finite BCE, and reload + CUDA backward are executed and reported. AUC is produced by an independent rank-based implementation with no quality gate. CUDA is required for all real work; no CPU fallback or mock weights are used. Only one training run is performed; no hyper-parameter search or ensemble.
